g.text: A Hybrid Web3 Architecture for Decentralized Blood Supply Chain and Verification
Pincode Search • Emergency Requests • QR Verify
• Zero gas fees for end users
GDPR / HIPAA Compliant: Never on chain
Smart Contract: RedFlow.sol (Solidity 0.8.20 @ Ganache Chain ID 5777)
Sensitive donor PII stays strictly in MongoDB
Public can verify blood bags with zero gas fees
Keccak-256 digests anchored on Ethereum EVM
